cat > /etc/rsyslog.d/10-tls.conf << 'EOF'
global(
  DefaultNetstreamDriver="gtls"
  DefaultNetstreamDriverCAFile="/etc/rsyslog/certs/ca.crt"
  DefaultNetstreamDriverCertFile="/etc/rsyslog/certs/server.crt"
  DefaultNetstreamDriverKeyFile="/etc/rsyslog/certs/server.key"
)

module(load="imtcp"
  StreamDriver.Name="gtls"
  StreamDriver.Mode="1"
  StreamDriver.AuthMode="anon"
)

template(name="RemoteFmt" type="string"
  string="%timegenerated:::date-rfc3339% %hostname% %syslogfacility-text% %syslogseverity-text% %syslogtag%%msg%\n")

ruleset(name="remote") {
  action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/remote.log" template="RemoteFmt")
}

input(type="imtcp" port="6514" ruleset="remote")

*.* action(type="omfwd" target="127.0.0.1" port="6514" protocol="tcp"
  StreamDriver="gtls" StreamDriverMode="1" StreamDriverAuthMode="anon")
EOF
